bounded_leaf_result.tested_scope: Abstract recurring-Chat Stage T protocols preserving one immutable logical_effect_id and exact (T,w,d), with role-local compare-and-swap checkpoint state and a target-authoritative verifier exposing q=(A,g,n,e) or a semantically equivalent immutable ordering witness. No concrete product/API capability is claimed.

checkpoint_state.q_last_initialization: If no prior comparable target-authoritative terminal witness has been durably consumed, q_last=null. q_last is advanced only by the CAS-winning consumption transition.

verifier_consumption_transition: 1. Validate candidate q against the same logical_effect_id,T,w,d, target authority A and terminal verdict. Missing or invalid binding returns UNRESOLVED_UNSAFE with mutation_permitted=false.

2. Compare q to durable q_last. Same (A,g,n,e) is replay/no-op. Same (A,g,n) with unequal e or verdict is EQUIVOCATION_UNSAFE. Incomparable authority/generation evidence is INCOMPARABLE_UNSAFE. Only target-authoritatively proven strict freshness is admissible.

3. For a strictly newer exact-scope terminal q, derive C_next from the current durable checkpoint: set q_last=q; preserve logical_effect_id,T,w,d; set mutation_permitted=false; and terminally resolve COMMIT_PROVEN_IN_SCOPE to COMMITTED or a proven conflict to CONFLICT. Reconciliation never transitions to a mutation-capable pre-attempt state.
4. Persist C_next with one role-local CAS against checkpoint_version/current state blob. The CAS commit is the consumption linearization point. No target mutation occurs in this transition.

5. If CAS loses, do not consume or retry in-run. A later recurrence rereads the durable winner. If the same q won, it now compares equal/replay and cannot be consumed again; if a strictly newer q won, the losing q is stale and cannot regress q_last.
6. Across target generations, advance only with target-authoritative successor proof; otherwise keep q_last unchanged and fail closed.
cas_race_proof: All contenders from the same checkpoint version race on one CAS-protected state object, so at most one C_next can commit for that version.

The winner durably stores q as q_last at the same linearization point that records its terminal interpretation. Therefore any later consumer of the identical q observes equality/replay rather than strict freshness.

A delayed contender carrying the pre-winner checkpoint version cannot overwrite the winner because its CAS precondition is stale. It performs no target mutation before the CAS and mutation_permitted is false throughout consumption.

If different strictly ordered terminal witnesses race, only one wins the current version; a later recurrence may consume only a witness strictly newer than the winner. A lower/equal witness cannot regress q_last.

Thus the same terminal evidence identity e cannot be durably consumed twice under checkpoint CAS races. The property is at-most-once consumption; eventual observation of the newest evidence depends on later recurring invocations and is not claimed by this slice.
no_rearm_proof: Verifier consumption has no transition to VERIFY_BEFORE_ATTEMPT or any state with mutation_permitted=true.
ATTEMPT_ARMED and VERIFY_PENDING remain crash-conservative unless strictly newer terminal evidence resolves them to COMMITTED or CONFLICT.

COMMITTED and CONFLICT remain monotonic terminal states; contradictory strictly newer terminal evidence becomes UNRESOLVED_UNSAFE and preserves mutation_permitted=false rather than reopening execution.
logical_effect_id,T,w,d are immutable across the consumption transition, so evidence processing cannot synthesize or rotate a second logical effect witness.

This removes any need for richer-mode arbitration in the tested abstract consumption path.
